ValidationRule.description: Ensures recurring invoices have all required fields
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "Recurring"), OR( ISBLANK(Recurring_Template_Name__c), ISBLANK(Recurring_Amount__c), ISPICKVAL(Frequency__c, ""), ISBLANK(Recurring_Start_Date__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Recurring invoices require Template Name, Amount, Frequency, and Start Date
